observations: Black mobility scooter with a grey upholstered seat and armrests.
Black handlebar with a basket attached.
Blue and white logo on the rear wheel hub.
The scooter is parked on a dirt or sandy surface outdoors.
A watermark 'TECHNOLOGY' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The motor may be non-functional or have seized gears.
risks.proof: A video of the scooter being driven or a photo of the motor compartment showing the engine.

risks.risk: The rear wheel may be damaged or have a flat tire.
risks.proof: A photo of the rear wheel with the scooter on its side.

risks.risk: The battery may be dead or unable to hold a charge.
risks.proof: A video of the scooter running on battery power.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the scooter being driven to confirm the motor and gears work.
Photo of the rear wheel with the scooter on its side.
Photo of the motor compartment to check for damage or missing parts.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
